headline: Discussion of e-bike and e-scooter use, safety, and enforcement with Police Chief Marc Gatcomb, plus school rules.
summary: Police Chief Marc Gatcomb will talk about how students and the public use e-bikes and e-scooters, and the laws and enforcement that apply. The meeting will also cover school rules, parking and storage, and possible next steps.
items: Current use of e-bikes and e-scooters by students and the public
Massachusetts laws and city ordinances that apply
Safety concerns on school property, sidewalks, roadways, and pedestrian areas
Enforcement authority, roles, and practical challenges
Existing district rules and possible policy gaps
Operation, parking, and storage on school property
Signage, designated areas, and coordination among administrators, school building monitors, and police
Whether more policies, regulations, or legal guidance are needed
Education and outreach for students and families
Recommendations for the full School Committee
location: Malden City Hall - Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden
